rule: Profit or loss on one card. If it is sold, the realised sale price against what was paid. Otherwise the current comp value against what was paid. A card with no value recorded returns nothing at all, because unvalued means unknown rather than worthless: treating it as zero reported every unpriced card as a total loss. A missing cost, by contrast, counts as zero, matching how total spend is summed.

cases.why: unrealised gain on a held card
realised: the sale price wins and comp value is ignored
sold with no price recorded has no realised figure yet, so no profit either
no comp value yet means unknown, not a loss of cost
listed but unsold is still valued at comp
a gift or unrecorded cost counts as free
